StateBatch.title: StateBatch
StateBatch.description: Metadata record representing an uploaded Excel block of survey responses (typically 100 people) for a specific Mexican state.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the researcher who uploaded the state block.

batchCode.description: Human-readable code for the state block upload.

entidad.description: Mexican state name associated with this study block.

fileName.description: Original Excel filename uploaded by the user.

recordsCount.description: Number of person records imported in this Excel block.

targetQuota.description: Target sample size per state block (standard: 100).

status.description: Terminal status of the committed batch.

OrusSurveyRecord.title: OrusSurveyRecord
OrusSurveyRecord.description: Complete 43-item ORUS questionnaire record stored in Firestore from Excel state blocks, direct survey capture, or saved simulations.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this study dataset record.

origin.description: Record classification between real field/Excel data and synthetic simulation.

batchId.description: Parent StateBatch ID when imported via Excel, or MANUAL.

entidad.description: Mexican state (P2) for state-level study aggregation.

clientRecordedAt.description: ISO timestamp of survey capture or Excel import.

registroCampo.description: Anonymized fieldwork metadata (alias, municipality/neighborhood, modality, interviewer code).

bloqueC.description: Block C concerns and local environment (P11-P16).

bloqueD.description: Block D institutional trust and public participation (P17-P25).

bloqueE.description: Block E access to rights, unpaid care impact, and autonomy (P26-P33).

bloqueF.description: Block F perception of Somos and other political parties (P34-P43).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp enforced by Firestore security rules.

/stateBatches/{batchId}.description: Stores metadata for uploaded Excel blocks per Mexican state.

/surveys/{surveyId}.description: Stores individual 43-item ORUS survey records linked to an owner and optional StateBatch.
